memory_candidates: In this codebase's FrameSoundness.lean-style frame-relativized soundness proofs, a weakened invariant whose edge conjunct becomes branch-content-driven (rather than a fixed fact about the model/accessibility pair) requires an explicit readiness/ordering side-condition on any 'add a new box/diamond formula to the branch' lemma -- the analogous strong-invariant lemma needs no such condition because its edge conjunct is branch-independent.

SoundnessStep.lean's Proposition.beqToEq is `private`; other files needing the same beq-to-eq conversion for Proposition should use `LawfulBEq.eq_of_beq` directly (the DecidableEq-derived BEq/LawfulBEq instances make this available with no import needed beyond what's already in scope).
